# Table

Rows and columns of comparable records, with headers.

## When to use it

- **Use it when:** Records people scan, sort or compare cell by cell.
- **Not when:** A grid of teasers (cards), or the shape of a relationship (chart).

Instead:

- [Data table](./data-table.md): Many records with search, filters and paging.
- [Chart](./chart.md): The shape of the numbers.

## How Accessible first uses it

<div class="odv-grid two"><div class="odv-dd"><div class="stage"><div class="odv-eyebrow">A number in a table</div><div style="margin-top:6px"><b style="color:var(--color-status-success)">Use</b> type.body</div><div><b style="color:var(--color-status-danger)">Not</b> A small or mono font</div></div><div class="cap">Every number must be readable at large size.</div></div><div class="odv-dd"><div class="stage"><div class="odv-eyebrow">A selected row or item</div><div style="margin-top:6px"><b style="color:var(--color-status-success)">Use</b> color.surface.selected and a check icon</div><div><b style="color:var(--color-status-danger)">Not</b> Color alone</div></div><div class="cap">Selection never relies on color alone.</div></div><div class="odv-dd"><div class="stage"><div class="odv-eyebrow">Table row height</div><div style="margin-top:6px"><b style="color:var(--color-status-success)">Use</b> size.row (large)</div><div><b style="color:var(--color-status-danger)">Not</b> A compact row</div></div><div class="cap">Large rows are easy to read and tap.</div></div></div>

## Words

- Use common words. Explain any term you must use.
- One idea per sentence. Put the action first.
- Never blame the person.
- Use: Continue, Change, Start, You. Avoid: Invalid, Utilise, Submit, Error code.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Continue
- `content.action.cancel`: Go back
- `content.action.destroy`: Delete
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Start a new application

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

Test before you ship:

- [ ] It has a caption and header cells, so each cell is read with its header. undefined

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add table
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.

## Component keys

The CSS variable is the key with `/` replaced by `-` and the base `@` dropped. Each key points to a token; values live only on primitives.

| Key | What it controls | Points to, light | Points to, dark |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `table/header-background` | Header row fill. | `color.surface.sunken` → `accessible-first.theme.light.color.surface.sunken` → `color.gray.light.100` | `color.surface.sunken` → `accessible-first.theme.dark.color.surface.sunken` → `color.gray.dark.100` |
| `table/row-height` | Height of one data row. | `size.row` → `size.56` | same |
| `table/cell-padding-x` | Horizontal padding inside a cell. | `space.inset.cell-x` → `space.16` | same |
| `table/row-border` | Line between rows. | `color.border.default` → `accessible-first.theme.light.color.border.default` → `color.gray.light.200` | `color.border.default` → `accessible-first.theme.dark.color.border.default` → `color.gray.dark.100` |
| `table/row-selected` | Fill of a selected row. | `color.surface.selected` → `accessible-first.theme.light.color.surface.selected` → `color.blue.light.100` | `color.surface.selected` → `accessible-first.theme.dark.color.surface.selected` → `color.blue.dark.100` |
| `table/font-size` | Cell text size. | `type.data.font-size` → `font.size.19` | same |
